title: Tech lead current-source evidence
description: Returned by the mandatory tech lead in both architecture-planning and architecture-review. It supplies source-backed insights, technology signals, and tradeoffs from current web research instead of Librarian-selected books. The coordinator owns final recommendations.

source_notes.description: Current technical sources selected by query relevance, not by a fixed site list.

published_or_observed.description: Date, version, commit, or 'not stated' when the source does not expose one.

insights.description: Source-backed current field context that affects the planning or review judgment.

architecture_evidence.description: The concrete code, design, constraint, or artifact examined through this current context.

applies_to.description: The exact option, finding, upheld practice, or proof concern shaped by this insight.

current_signal.description: Current version, API behavior, limit, maturity signal, adoption signal, or operational note.

relevance.description: Why this technology signal matters to the architecture question.

applies_to.description: The option, finding, upheld practice, or proof concern shaped by this tradeoff.

assumptions.description: Missing facts, unavailable sources, or web-search limitations that could change the brief.
